title: MOTION (RAMAN - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding for costs associated with activity supplies, decorations, and other event materials for the Reseda…
text:
[Council File 26-1440]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RAMAN - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding for costs associated with activity supplies, decorations, and other event materials for the Reseda Recreation Center's Halloween Community Event on October 31, 2026.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $4,000.00 from AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281204 (CD 4 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Recreation and Parks Fund No. 301/88, Account No. 042M for costs associated with activity supplies, decorations, and other event materials for the Reseda Recreation Center's Halloween Community Event on October 31, 2026.
AUTHORIZE the Department of Recreation and Parks to make any corrections, clarifications, or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
summary: Moves $4,000 from Council District 4 redevelopment funds to pay for supplies and decorations for the Reseda Recreation Center's Halloween event on October 31.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026)
